author: shoop_raton
body:
Hola,

Me and SenseiTechUS were talking about old, removed maps such as Luar and Campi Embrosi, and Sensei said, "Maybe they should make a Nebula rotation with removed or old maps from the MCZone days", so I decided to make a forum post about it :p. You guys could call it "Archived01" and it will have maps such as Luar, Campi Embrosi, etc.

I hope you guys take this into consideration :]

-Seuth, SenseiTechUS
